faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIBD Engagement Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Engagement Manager position at Digital India Bhashini Division is 30 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Engagement Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Engagement Manager post in the Digital India Bhashini Division recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Engagement Manager role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a full-time B.S./B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent, or B.Sc. (IT/CS) with Post Graduation. An MBA/MTech is preferable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Engagement Manager position is 58 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the DIBD Engagement Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Engagement Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Engagement Manager role involves Screening followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Engagement Manager position is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the location for this Engagement Manager post?
faq.answer: The Engagement Manager post is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required experience for the Engagement Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have at least 5 years of experience in IT solutions sales or consulting.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the DIBD Engagement Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of Digital India Bhashini Division or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
